title: Nudibranchia & Allied Nudipleura (Gastropoda: Heterobranchia) 64-species x 16-locus design (PREPRINT-25 dimensions) vs. published phylogenomics
purpose: End-to-end seqnet -> RuNIE validation sweep at the dataset dimensions of PREPRINT-25 (nudibranch-global-radiation-preprint): 64 species and 16 loci, with 14 mitochondrial loci (12 PCGs + 16S rrnL + 12S rrnS) phased from complete/partial mitogenomes plus nuclear 18S (SSU_18S) and 28S (LSU_28S) rRNA. PREPRINT-25 only sets the taxon strata and quotas; it is not a validation source. Final trees are scored against inter-family and suborder clades reported in the peer-reviewed studies below. A clade is testable when the run samples >= 2 tips inside and >= 2 outside it, and recovered when the unrooted tree contains the corresponding bipartition.

design_reference.taxon_design: 4 Tectipleura outgroups (2 Aplysiidae, 2 Plakobranchidae), 5 sister Pleurobranchida (4 Pleurobranchidae, 1 Pleurobranchaeidae), 21 Cladobranchia (4 Tritoniidae, 1 Tethydidae, 1 Dendronotidae, 1 Dotidae, 2 Arminidae, 1 Janolidae, 3 Aeolidiidae, 6 Facelinidae, 1 Flabellinidae, 1 Trinchesiidae), and 34 Doridina (2 Hexabranchidae, 1 Aegiridae, 6 Polyceridae, 4 Dorididae, 3 Discodorididae, 1 Dendrodorididae, 4 Phyllidiidae, 4 Cadlinidae, 9 Chromodorididae).
design_reference.taxonomy_note: NCBI Taxonomy places Bathydoridoidea/Hexabranchus in Hexabranchidae, Coryphella verrucosa in Coryphellidae (grouped here with Flabellinidae following classical aeolid assignments and Goodheart et al. 2017/2018), Janolus hyalinus in Zephyrinidae/Janolidae, and Cadlina/Aldisa under Cadlinidae/Chromodorididae/Dorididae; curated complete mitogenome accessions guarantee full 64-taxon representation alongside live seqnet queries.
design_reference.locus_interpretation: 14 mitochondrial loci (12 PCGs COI..ATP6 excluding hypervariable ATP8 + rrnL_16S + rrnS_12S) extracted from verified complete Heterobranchia mitogenomes plus nuclear SSU_18S and LSU_28S rRNA = 16 orthologous phylogenomic loci. Multi-copy physiological nuclear families (cathepsin L, Hsp70, nAChR alpha, Clan-3 CYP3A) remain in Stage 4 codon-selection tests rather than the species-level orthogonal panel.
